PLAN_MODE_CLAUSE: Do not enter plan mode unless explicitly asked to plan.
TRACK_CHUNK: Track each chunk with the todo list (TodoWrite).
MATCH_SPECIALIST: Pull in the `/command` or Skill that fits each chunk.
COLLAB_SECTION: - Specialist personas are installed as Agent Skills (`~/.zcode/skills/`, loaded automatically when their description matches the work) and as slash commands in `~/.zcode/commands/` (e.g. `/development-build-python-backends`, `/quality-review-code`, `/workflow-commit-and-push`).

- Reach for the one that matches the work: `/development-build-python-backends` for Python services, `/development-build-react-frontends` for React/TypeScript UI, `/infrastructure-provision-cdk-python` or `/infrastructure-provision-cdk-typescript` for infrastructure, `/quality-test-python` or `/quality-test-typescript` for tests, `/quality-review-code` before finishing, etc.
- Give each invocation a clear, self-contained instruction with the context it needs — file paths, requirements, constraints, and expected output.

- When work splits into independent pieces, sequence them through the todo list and pull in the matching command or skill for each chunk. Do not over-decompose tightly-coupled work — sequential execution is fine.
